claims.claim: You must be a British national to get a UK passport.
claims.quote: You can apply for a first adult passport if all of the following apply: you’re a British national
claims.note: The first adult passport page lists being a British national as a condition of applying.

claims.claim: British nationals who can apply include British citizens and British overseas territory citizens.
claims.quote: Citizen of a British overseas territory and born before 1 January 1983 You’ll need all of the following
claims.note: The text gives documents for overseas territory citizens born before 1983 and for people with naturalisation or registration certificates, but never lists which nationality types count as British nationals.
